title: Run a command without saving it to history
summary: Execute a command without adding it to your command history. This is useful for commands containing passwords or sensitive data that you do not want saved.

aliases.text: zapustit komandu ne sohranyaya v istoriyu

steps.explain: Add a leading space before the command to prevent it from being saved to history.

placeholders.name: COMMAND
placeholders.description: The command you want to run.

steps.expect: The command runs, but does not appear in the history list.
